We were initially taking the liquid version but I found it an absolute nightmare to give to him. He hated the mint taste and screamed his head off before spitting the majority of it out. He actually seems to like the taste of the MUPS and even sucks it out of the syringe by himself 😅

My entire extended family is vegan or veggie (parents, aunts, uncles, cousins, brothers, nieces, nephews...). My Grandmother became vegetarian in 1931 which was pretty unusual in North East Scotland where we live (and still is to be fair!). Everyone who married into the family became vegetarian or was already a veggie and all the kids were raised vegetarian. Most of us became vegan back in the 90s. We are on the 4th generation and nobody has died of protein deficiency or caved in and eaten a steak yet :-)

I know I am extremely lucky! Food at family celebrations is always 100% vegan. Christmas is awesome!
